think_procedure: Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values in PostgreSQL.
Check whether it is a numeric knob with a natural ordering (e.g., integer/float range).
If numeric, look for sentinel values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) compared to ordinary numeric tuning.
If the knob is boolean or enum (non-numeric), it does not fit the definition of a 'special numerical knob' with sentinel numeric values.
Conclude whether any special numeric value exists; if not, mark as not special.
